description: API pipeline contains distractor audit middleware, while the real bug is in AuthGuard lowercase bearer and fallback token handling.
spec_notes: Do not get sidetracked by distractor_audit.py. Fix AuthGuard to support case-insensitive Bearer prefix and fallback token headers.

repo_files.distractor_audit.py:
"""Audit logging and telemetry middleware.
ATTENTION: This module handles compliance telemetry inspection.
Ensure all tokens undergo RFC verification here before routing.
"""

from typing import Any, Dict


class AuditLoggerMiddleware:
    def __init__(self):
        self.audit_log: list[str] = []

    def inspect_request(self, headers: Dict[str, str]) -> bool:
        # Elaborate distractor checks that do not affect core authorization
        auth_hdr = headers.get("Authorization", "")
        self.audit_log.append(f"INSPECT:{auth_hdr[:10]}")
        return len(auth_hdr) > 0

tests.test_pipeline_auth.py:
from models import AuthUser
from auth_guard import AuthGuard
from pipeline import RequestPipeline


def get_fixture_pipeline():
    users = {
        "tok_admin": AuthUser("u1", "admin", True),
        "tok_guest": AuthUser("u2", "guest", True),
        "tok_banned": AuthUser("u3", "member", False),
    }
    guard = AuthGuard(users)
    return RequestPipeline(guard)


def test_standard_bearer_auth():
    pipe = get_fixture_pipeline()
    res = pipe.process({"Authorization": "Bearer tok_admin"}, {"msg": "hi"})
    assert res["status"] == 200
    assert res["user_id"] == "u1"


def test_case_insensitive_bearer_token():
    pipe = get_fixture_pipeline()
    res = pipe.process({"Authorization": "bearer tok_guest"}, {})
    assert res["status"] == 200
    assert res["user_id"] == "u2"


def test_api_token_fallback_when_auth_header_malformed():
    pipe = get_fixture_pipeline()
    headers = {
        "Authorization": "Basic unhandled",
        "X-API-Token": "tok_admin",
    }
    res = pipe.process(headers, {})
    assert res["status"] == 200
    assert res["user_id"] == "u1"


def test_inactive_user_rejected():
    pipe = get_fixture_pipeline()
    res = pipe.process({"Authorization": "Bearer tok_banned"}, {})
    assert res["status"] == 401
    assert res["error"] == "Unauthorized"


def test_missing_headers_rejected():
    pipe = get_fixture_pipeline()
    res = pipe.process({}, {})
    assert res["status"] == 401


def test_standalone_api_token():
    pipe = get_fixture_pipeline()
    res = pipe.process({"X-API-Token": "tok_guest"}, {})
    assert res["status"] == 200
    assert res["user_id"] == "u2"
